sql.soql: SELECT id_contrato, referencia_del_contrato, nombre_entidad, departamento, ciudad, objeto_del_contrato, descripcion_del_proceso, tipo_de_contrato, modalidad_de_contratacion, valor_del_contrato, valor_facturado, estado_contrato, fecha_de_firma, proveedor_adjudicado, documento_proveedor, urlproceso WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) ORDER BY fecha_de_firma DESC, valor_del_contrato DESC, id_contrato DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false))

SELECT nombre_entidad, count(*) AS cnt WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) GROUP BY nombre_entidad ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT avg(valor_del_contrato) AS mean, min(valor_del_contrato) AS min_val, max(valor_del_contrato) AS max_val WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) AND valor_del_contrato IS NOT NULL

SELECT modalidad_de_contratacion, count(*) AS cnt WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) GROUP BY modalidad_de_contratacion ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT min(fecha_de_firma) AS date_min, max(fecha_de_firma) AS date_max WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) AND fecha_de_firma IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_trunc_y(fecha_de_firma) AS yr, count(*) AS cnt WHERE NOT (coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(objeto_del_contrato)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false) OR coalesce(unaccent(UPPER(descripcion_del_proceso)) LIKE unaccent(UPPER('%fundacaribe%')), false)) AND fecha_de_firma IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr DESC
